Filter commands are [[Linux]] commands used to do simple tasks.

Examples

* [[head]]
* [[tail]]
* [[grep]]
Simple filter commands

* filtering rows: [[head]], [[tail]], [[uniq]]
* filtering columns: [[cut]]
* Filtering characters: [[tr]]
* Others: [[comm]], [[cmp]], [[diff]], and [[paste]], and [[sort]]
* Stream editing with [[sed]]

Putting filters together

* [[grep]] and regular expressions
